title: Guidance.
bodyText: The department of law enforcement, in consultation with the Hawaii civil rights commission, shall provide guidance to the public on the civil liability and remedies available for discriminatory reporting to a law enforcement officer pursuant to this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§368H-2]  Guidance.  The department of law enforcement, in consultation with the Hawaii civil rights commission, shall provide guidance to the public on the civil liability and remedies available for discriminatory reporting to a law enforcement officer pursuant to this chapter. [L 2025, c 259, pt of §2]
